title: Mai Kaise Rokoo\'n
body:
Mai kaise rokoo\'n
Kehte the sayyad e abraar me kaise rokoo’n
Ghaiz me he mera jarra me kaise rokoo’n
Ey bahan phir mere ghazi ko jalal aaya he
<<DIVIDER>>
1-Jab kabhi bhi mere ghazi ko kahee’n ghaiz aya
Aastee’n ulte huye bar sar e maidaa’n paaya
Karbala door hai har baar yehi samjhaya
Karbala  aa gaei is baar me kaise rokoo’n………………1
<<DIVIDER>>
2-Hai abhi waqt bin e saad sanbhal likha hai
Khat nahi khencha fisadaat ka hal likkha hai
Dushmano ke liye paigham e ajal likha hai
Ghaiz me hai mera jarra me kaise roko’n……2
<<DIVIDER>>
3-Khak me khak ke paikar ko mila sakta hai
Bani e zul ki sarkar gira sakta hai
Dasht me lasho’n ke ambar laga sakta hai
Jung karne ko hai tayyar me kaise rokoo’n……3
<<DIVIDER>>
4-Dar ye hai aag laga de na kahee’n paani me
Malakulmaut bhi is dam hai pareshani me
Karbala aati hai ghazi ki nigehbani me
Hath me nangi hai talwar me kaise rokoo’n…..4
<<DIVIDER>>
5-Jauhar e nafs sar e dasht dikhane ke liye
Ey behan kaise kahoo’n kheme hatane ke liye
Ham yaha’n aaye hain islam bachane ke liye
Rokna aaj hai dushwar me kaise rokko’n…….…5
<<DIVIDER>>
6-Teer talwar tabar neza o khanjar kya hai
Saamne aaye to nau lakh ka lashkar kya hai
Khud bata dega dua e dil e haider kya hai
Hai qayamat ke se aasaar me kaise roko’m….…..6
<<DIVIDER>>
7-Jaanta hoo’ ke wafadar hai mera bhai
Mera monis mera ghamkhar hai mera bhai
Mujh pe jaa’n dene ko tayyar hai mera bhai phir bhi ey zenab e  lachaar me kaise rokoo’n….….8
8 -Jisko zehra ne kaha mera pisar hai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo dua e dil e haider ka samar hai Abbas
Khandaan e  bani Hashim ka Qamar hai Abbas
Aaj kya keh ke karoo’n pyaar me kaise rokoo’n…… 9-bil yaqee’n aamir o Asif ye wafao’n ka imam
Aastee’n ulte ulat jaye zamane ka nizam
<<DIVIDER>>
Dam me nau lakh ke lashkar ka kare jeena haram
Bach ke jaye’n na sitamgaar me kaise rokooo’n…………9
